rules_text.raw: When determining the spell’s effect on non-mythic creatures, add your tier to your caster level. Nonevil creatures that fail the save take a –4 penalty on attack rolls and saving throws, and their spell resistance decreases by 5 for as long as the spell’s other effects last.
